sections.Profile:
"Crazy Ball" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company on July 7, 1948.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Baseball, Sports, Original Theme
sections.Editions: - Crazy Ball: 900 made, released 1948-07-07, model number 115
